limits: The exact304 requested observations are exported from the two stopped campaigns only; other closed WP6 cohorts (including classroom) are outside this folder.
No result-based filter: setup refusals, negative checker results, disagreements and null ground truth are retained.
Interrupted attempts are missing observations, not scientific failures. Failed worker attempts do not enter outcomes.
Engineering performance repeats, including the failed hybrid MemoryError trial, are excluded from scientific outcomes.
Later original batches, all other native variants and natural-diff mutants remain outside this incomplete coverage.
Scripted backend responses are offline test fixtures, not real model generations. HTTP commit/evidence execution is outside Driver.probe scope.
scientific_unit: Mutant model. Agent-object pairs and backend variants within a model are correlated.
scope: Bounded completed data from two stopped original WP6 campaigns; not all WP6
